title: 2002 AMC 10A Problem 25
statement: In trapezoid \(ABCD\) with bases \(\overline{AB}\) and \(\overline{CD},\) we have \(AB=52,\) \(BC=12,\) \(CD=39,\) and \(DA=5.\) The area of \(ABCD\) is

solutions.text:
Extend \(DA\) and \(CB\) to meet at \(P.\) Since \(DC\parallel AB,\) \(\triangle PDC\sim\triangle PAB\) with ratio \(\dfrac{39}{52}=\dfrac{3}{4}.\) From \(\dfrac{PD}{PD+5}=\dfrac{3}{4}\) we get \(PD=15,\) and similarly \(PC=36.\)

Then \(PD:PC:DC=15:36:39\) \(=3\cdot(5:12:13),\) so \(\angle P\) is a right angle. The area of \(ABCD\) is \[ \begin{gathered} \dfrac{1}{2}(PA)(PB) \\ {}-\dfrac{1}{2}(PD)(PC) \\ = \dfrac{1}{2}(20)(48) \\ {}-\dfrac{1}{2}(15)(36) \\ = 480-270=210. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Extend the legs \(DA\) and \(CB\) until they meet at a point \(P\)
